stages.name: Elementary school (K–5)
stages.blurb: Numbers, reading and writing, science and the world around us, plus money: counting it, earning it, saving it and spending it wisely, learned with a grown-up close by.

stages.name: Middle school (6–8)
stages.blurb: Ratios to algebra, reading and writing, the sciences and history, plus Python programming and financial literacy: banking, budgets, interest and credit.

stages.name: High school (9–12)
stages.blurb: Algebra through calculus and statistics, the lab sciences, English and history, plus Python with data, a full personal finance course and AP-level economics.

stages.name: College finance degree
stages.blurb: The core of a finance degree: financial and managerial accounting, economics, statistics and quantitative methods, corporate finance, markets and institutions, financial reporting and analysis, investments, fixed income, derivatives, valuation, portfolio management, Python for finance, international finance, risk, behavioral finance, and law, ethics and regulation.

stages.name: CFA Program and investment career
stages.blurb: CFA Program Levels I, II and III, equity research and financial modeling, a capstone research report, and the ethics and practice of the investment profession.
